summary: Neuronetics, Inc. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an underwritten follow-on offering of 18,750,000 shares of common stock at $1.6000 per share, raising $30.0 million gross ($28.2 million net before expenses) against a $2.01 last sale on November 10, 2026, implying roughly a 20% discount. William Blair leads, with BTIG and Canaccord Genuity as bookrunners; a 2,812,500-share (15%) overallotment option runs 30 days. Certain directors indicated non-binding interest in purchasing. Mechanics show ~9% dilution plus option overhang; watch pricing pressure and insider participation as an ordinary capital raise, not a special situation.
